summary: With Podman installed and the EE file open, ask 'How do I build this execution environment?' and the assistant generates an ansible-builder command for your file and tag, e.g. ansible-builder build --file execution-environment.yml --context ./context --tag webserver-ee:1.0 -vvv, to run in the terminal.
questions: How do I build my execution environment image?
ansible-builder build command example with tag
Can the AI assistant give me the ansible-builder command?

answer_card.title: Build an EE with ansible-builder
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-builder build --file execution-environment.yml --context ./context --tag webserver-ee:1.0 -vvv
```
Needs a container runtime such as Podman. You can ask Copilot *How do I build this execution environment?* to get the command for your own file and tag.
